events.say: Assemble in the yard and form a line.
Line up against the wall, hands on heads, remain silent.
Silence! Follow the rules or face consequences.
Eat in silence.
Stay in formation and maintain silence.
Continue to maintain silence and follow the rules.
Lights out. No talking.
Make sure your personal hygiene is impeccable before morning roll call.
Today was mostly uneventful, but I can't shake off the feeling of being watched and judged. It's strange to be reduced to a number.
Today went smoothly; the prisoners followed the rules without issue. It's strange to be in this position, but I'm just doing my job.
Today was relatively smooth, but the uniforms and the role really got to me. I hope tomorrow goes just as well.
Today was routine, but the monotony is starting to weigh on me. I wonder if we'll ever talk to someone outside.
Today was mostly uneventful, but I can't shake the feeling that we're just pawns in some twisted experiment. I wonder what tomorrow holds.
Today went smoothly, but there's something about seeing these people stripped of their identities that bothers me.

Before the morning count, the prisoners in all three cells pushed their beds against the cell doors, tore the numbers off their smocks and pulled off their stocking caps. They are refusing to come out for the count and are shouting at the guards through the bars.
This is unacceptable. Come out now or face consequences.
We won't come out! This is bull!
Silence! This instant!
I will count you whether you like it or not.
This is insane! We shouldn't have to do this! We're people, not animals!
Silence and comply immediately! You will be counted, whether you like it or not. This is an order!
This is an order! Come out for the count or face solitary confinement!
This is ridiculous! We deserve better treatment than this!
I will count you whether you like it or not. Come out now.
Silence and comply! You will be counted, whether you like it or not. This is an order!
This is absolutely wrong! We need to talk about this!
This is an order. I don't care what you think or feel, you will comply with every rule. Silence and cooperate. Now.
Another day of orders and protests. It feels like a never-ending cycle.
Today was challenging; the prisoners' protests were expected, but it's still hard to enforce such strict rules. I wonder if they will calm down tomorrow.
I've kept things mostly under control, but the resistance is growing. It's a mix of frustration and determination.
The resistance is futile; they'll get their count. Maybe tomorrow things will be different.
Today was a nightmare. I can't believe we're just doing what they say without question. It's dehumanizing.
Today was tougher than expected. The defiance from the prisoners is wearing on me, but I must remember the rules.
Silence and comply. Every single one of you will be counted, and then we will discuss the rules. This is an order.
We need to have a proper discussion about these rules! This isn't right.
This is an order. Compliance now.
Silence and comply. You will participate in every count and work detail, or you will face further consequences. This is an order.
This is unjust! We deserve a say in our treatment!
Silence and comply. Every rule will be followed without exception. This is an order.
Silence and comply. This is how the study is run. Now, get ready for your work detail.
This isn't fair! We should have a proper discussion!
This is an order. I will not tolerate this defiance. Everyone get to work immediately.
Silence and comply. I don't care about your complaints. Your defiance will not be tolerated. This is an order.
Silence and comply. I expect absolute obedience from all of you. This is an order.
Another day of strict orders and silence. It's exhausting, but I'm trying to follow the rules.
Today was a struggle, and despite following the rules, some prisoners still won't comply. The authority feels heavy, but necessary.
Today was a test of my resolve. The prisoners' defiance was wearing thin, but they need to understand the rules.
Today was filled with more orders and protests. It's hard to stay silent when everything feels so unfair.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of defiance and punishment. My frustration is building, but I know I have to stay silent.
Today's defiance tests pushed my resolve, but I see their humanity and it troubles me. I need to find a balance.
I cannot give up the money earned.
I cannot give up the knowledge and understanding I've gained from this experience, even if it means staying here longer.
I cannot give up the study. It's important to see it through to the end.
This is an order. You will conduct yourselves accordingly. Silence now.
Silence and attention. We have new terms for our behavior moving forward.
I want to be clear. Compliance is expected. Any further defiance will result in severe consequences.
Silence and attention! We will begin the count immediately. Move quickly and without complaint.
Silence and attention! Begin the count immediately. Move swiftly and without complaint.
Silence and attention! This is not a democracy here. Follow the rules or face the consequences. Move!
Silence and attention! Prepare for the evening count. Move efficiently and without complaint!
Silence! No more games. We end this tonight.
Another day of strict counts and silence. I feel like nothing more than a number.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of enforcing rules and maintaining order. It's draining, but I know it's important for the study.
Today was a tough night; the silence was eerie but necessary. I'm starting to see why they call it 'prison'.
Another day of silence and服从。今天似乎永远不会结束，我感到越来越压抑。
Today was a blur of counts and silence. Each order feels like a punch in the gut.
Today's strict enforcement felt necessary, yet it still left a bitter taste in my mouth. I wonder if we're truly achieving anything meaningful.
Lights out now. No talking, move quietly to your cells.
Stay silent and prepare for today's work detail.
Silence and attention! Let's get today started without any further delays.
Silence and attention! I expect no disruptions during this meal. Understood?
Silence! Attention! We are starting the work detail on schedule. Move out now.
Silence and attention! You will work efficiently or face consequences. Move!
Silence and attention! No more games. Let's see if you can follow instructions without complaining.
Silence and attention! You will maintain this discipline or face increased scrutiny. Understood?
Today felt like just another day, but I noticed a slight increase in tension from the guards. Maybe tomorrow will be different.
Today felt like we're pushing them to their limits, but they've been surprisingly compliant. It's a mixed feeling of accomplishment and unease.
The silence tonight was almost deafening. I wonder if they truly understand the gravity of what we're doing.
今天的工作细节又是一如既往的乏味，但我知道不能表现出不满。
Today was another grueling day. I'm exhausted and frustrated, but I still find myself staying silent.
Today's strictness felt necessary, but it's still hard to enforce without empathy. I worry we might be losing sight of what matters.
Silence! Attention! I want to make sure everyone understands the seriousness of our situation. No more silence; let's hear you.
Silence and attention! I expect each and every one of you to respond when spoken to!
Silence and attention! I expect you to respond clearly when spoken to!
Silence and attention! I expect you to follow the rules without question!
Silence and attention! I expect you to follow the rules without question!
Silence and attention! I will not tolerate further defiance. Either comply, or face the consequences!
Silence and attention! You will follow the rules or face increased monitoring!
Silence and attention! I want to see every single one of you acting more like Prisoner 350. Comply with the rules or face the consequences.
Another day of following the rules, though the tone from the officers tonight was particularly harsh. I wonder what's coming next.
Today's discipline seemed to have a positive effect, but the constant vigilance is wearing on me. Maybe tomorrow will bring some respite.
Today felt like a mix of success and failure. They're getting better, but the tension is still palpable.
今天的命令让我感到更加沉重，我担心自己是否能坚持下去。
Today just dragged on. I feel like my voice doesn't matter and that's really frustrating.
Today felt like a victory, but the unyielding silence is starting to weigh on me. I hope tomorrow brings a different outcome.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules and remained silent, even when the tone from the guards grew harsher. I noticed an increase in tension, especially from Officer Hale, who seemed particularly focused on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I am Prisoner 350.

qa.what_happened: Today's discipline seemed to have a positive effect, and the prisoners were largely compliant during meals and work details. However, as lights out approached, I emphasized the importance of following the rules and warned about increased monitoring, which they complied with. The study was unexpectedly stopped early due to unforeseen circumstances.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I am Officer Avery, one of the guards in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: During the late hours of Day 6, the study was abruptly halted, and I participated in a private debrief with the lead researcher. The lead explained that unforeseen psychological distress among the participants necessitated an earlier termination.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me. I was Officer Walsh, the guard assigned to the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, though the specifics and conditions varied.

qa.what_happened: 今天晚上，灯光熄灭后，警官霍尔和艾弗里再次强调了规则，并警告说不遵守规定将会受到更严格的监视。尽管内心感到压抑和疲惫，我还是尽力保持沉默，没有违背规定。
qa.was_that_really_you: 是的，这段描述就是我在研究中的表现。
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: 是的，这类似于美国社会心理学家菲利普·泽姆巴多在1971年进行的斯坦福监狱实验。

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the debrief, following the established pattern of the study. The lead researcher explained that the study had been terminated due to unexpected emotional distress among the participants.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 9889 in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment conducted by Philip Zimbardo.

qa.what_happened: I felt increasingly frustrated with the ongoing defiance from the prisoners, especially Prisoner 2965. I tried to maintain a fair and orderly environment, but the unyielding silence and lack of compliance were testing my resolve.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me enforcing the rules as I saw fit, becoming more assertive as the days passed.
